name: Sisera
overview: Sisera, the captain of a Canaanite army, faced divine opposition as the stars and the Kishon River fought against him, leading to his defeat by Barak and his eventual death at the hand of Jael. The victory is marked by God's judgment on those who failed to support His cause, as seen in the curse upon Meroz. Jael's blessing above women highlights God's sovereign use of unexpected instruments to accomplish His purposes.
